carousels.title: Lenders pull new credit model but do not price with it
carousels.cover_text: Pulling a new credit score without pricing risk
carousels.caption:
More than 170 lenders are pulling the new VantageScore 4.0 model, yet very few are using it for actual loan pricing. This half-in approach creates a massive operational disconnect for lenders and investors alike. As someone who spent a decade clearing conditions in underwriting, I can tell you that looking at a data point you refuse to price is just expensive window dressing. Until secondary markets fully adopt these scores for execution, lenders are essentially paying twice for data they cannot monetize. Read on to see why the industry is stuck in neutral on credit model updates.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/2bhsqp4c
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #mortgagelending #creditscore #housingmarket
carousels.hook: Over 170 lenders are pulling the new credit model, but nobody is pricing with it.
carousels.what_happened: More than 170 lenders are now pulling VS4, but relatively few are using it as their pricing score. This creates a strange gap between data collection and actual loan execution.

breakdown.heading: Collecting data without an execution strategy
breakdown.body: Lenders are integrating new technology pipelines to pull alternative credit data, but their secondary market desks have no framework to trade loans priced on these metrics.

breakdown.heading: The investor hesitation holding back adoption
breakdown.body: Wall Street investors and the GSEs (Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac) still rely heavily on legacy scoring models for mortgage-backed securities, stalling real-world utility.

breakdown.heading: Underwriting friction on dual models
breakdown.body: Here is what this actually changes when a file hits underwriting: processors now have to look at conflicting scores without clear guidelines on which number rules approval.

breakdown.heading: Technology costs versus tangible revenue
breakdown.body: Software vendors sell the upgrade as future-proofing, but executive balance sheets take an immediate hit for credit reports that do not change the final rate stack.

carousels.my_take_heading: An expensive habit of data hoarding
carousels.my_take: Collecting data you refuse to price is not innovation. It is just an expensive way to look busy.
carousels.action_lo: Ask your credit reporting vendor which of your secondary investors actually accept loans priced on VS4 before changing your pitch.
carousels.action_realtor: Do not stress over new credit model headlines with clients; traditional scores still dictate what closes today.
carousels.cta_question: Are your secondary investors showing any real appetite for new credit scoring models yet, or is everyone waiting out the GSEs on the sidelines?

carousels.title: Adjudication method aims to preserve evidence for AI overrides
carousels.cover_text: When human underwriters override artificial intelligence tools
carousels.caption:
As algorithms take over more initial mortgage decisions, the friction between human reviewers and automated engines is reaching a boiling point. A new adjudication protocol aims to track overrides, preserve evidence, and assign accountability when humans disagree with machine logic. From an underwriter pipeline perspective, this is the most critical workflow shift of the decade. We are moving from gut-check approvals to audited machine collaborations. Read on to discover how tracking human overrides changes file liability forever.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/24flrv5k
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #loanofficer #mortgageunderwriter #realestate
carousels.hook: What happens when a human underwriter flat-out disagrees with artificial intelligence?
carousels.what_happened_heading: A new framework for algorithmic disputes
carousels.what_happened: A practical adjudication method has been introduced to preserve evidence, assign authority, and track the exact time spent on human overrides of AI decisions. This protocol establishes clear chains of custody for automated loan determinations.

breakdown.heading: The growing friction in modern operations
breakdown.body: Automated underwriting systems spit out clear-cut approvals or denials, but complex borrower profiles often force experienced human staff to override the machine logic.

breakdown.heading: Tracking the cost of human intervention
breakdown.body: Operations managers need to track how many hours underwriters spend untangling automated findings, directly impacting turn times and cost-per-loan metrics.

breakdown.heading: Preserving liability when exceptions occur
breakdown.body: Here is what this actually changes when a file hits underwriting: every time a human rejects an AI finding, they must log airtight documentation to protect against future buybacks.

breakdown.heading: Eliminating the wild west of overrides
breakdown.body: Without a formal protocol, loan officers often pressure underwriters to bypass machine warnings informally, creating massive compliance blind spots for executive teams.

carousels.my_take_heading: The audit trail is the new loan file
carousels.my_take: If you override the algorithm without a paper trail, you are just volunteering to take the blame when the loan defaults.
carousels.action_lo: Learn your shop's exact override policy so you can set proper timeline expectations with realtors when automation flags a file.
carousels.action_realtor: Understand that AI delays are increasingly about liability tracking, not laziness from the operations desk.
carousels.cta_question: Are your operations teams logging AI overrides yet, or are underwriters still relying on sticky notes and informal chats?

carousels.title: NAMB opposes VA loan fee increases in Senate bill
carousels.cover_text: Pushback on permanent VA loan fee hikes
carousels.caption:
Legislation passed by the House would lift VA IRRRL funding fees to 1.42% and make higher charges permanent, drawing sharp opposition from industry groups like NAMB. While lawmakers view these fees as a funding mechanism, originators know it directly impacts military families looking to lower their monthly payments. When the government tacks extra basis points onto government-backed loans, it eats right into the borrower's purchasing power. Read on to see why this legislative fight matters to your pipeline.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/2dkfat5v
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #mortgagebroker #veterans #housingmarket
carousels.hook: Congress wants to make higher VA loan fees permanent, and brokers are pushing back.
carousels.what_happened_heading: The fight over permanent fee hikes
carousels.what_happened: Legislation passed by the House would lift IRRRL (Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan) fees to 1.42% and make higher charges permanent. The National Association of Mortgage Brokers is actively opposing this move in the Senate.

breakdown.heading: Targeting the streamline refinance market
breakdown.body: The proposed fee hike specifically impacts veterans trying to utilize streamline refinancing options to lower their monthly housing debt during high-rate environments.

breakdown.heading: Shifting costs to those who served
breakdown.body: Industry advocates argue that balancing federal budgets on the backs of military borrowers through inflated funding fees defeats the core purpose of the VA benefit.

breakdown.heading: Impact on total loan amounts
breakdown.body: Here is what this actually changes when a file hits underwriting: higher upfront fees get rolled directly into the loan amount, raising the baseline LTV (loan-to-value ratio) calculations.

breakdown.heading: The legislative battle in the Senate
breakdown.body: NAMB's direct opposition forces lawmakers to justify whether these revenue-generating fees unfairly penalize military homeowners compared to conventional borrowers.

carousels.my_take_heading: Taxing the military to balance ledgers
carousels.my_take: Calling a government fee an investment while it raises the barrier to homeownership for veterans is pure Washington doublespeak.
carousels.action_lo: Reach out to your past VA borrowers and explain how pending Senate legislation could impact future streamline refinancing options.
carousels.action_realtor: Educate your military buyer clients on total loan costs so upfront funding fee changes do not shock them at closing.
carousels.cta_question: Do you expect the Senate to roll back these VA fee increases, or will military borrowers end up footing the bill?

carousels.title: Figure CEO says AI could cut DSCR loan process to days
carousels.cover_text: Cutting investor loan timelines down to days
carousels.caption:
Figure Technology Solutions is aiming to shrink DSCR loan processing times from several weeks down to just days by leveraging artificial intelligence. Following its acquisition of Kiavi, the company is automating document reviews, property valuations, and portfolio analysis for real estate investors. Speed is everything in investor lending, but automation has historically stumbled on messy rental income schedules. Read on to find out if AI can actually solve the underwriting bottleneck for investment properties.

Source : https://tinyurl.com/2342zfb6
#SafetrustMortgage #MortgageIntelligenceDaily #realestateinvesting #mortgagetech #investors
carousels.hook: Can artificial intelligence really cut investment property loan approvals down to a few days?
carousels.what_happened_heading: A new speed standard for investor loans
carousels.what_happened: Figure Technology Solutions is aiming to cut the time it takes to process DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) loans from several weeks to days. They are using artificial intelligence to automate underwriting as they expand into investor lending following their acquisition of Kiavi.

breakdown.heading: Targeting the slowest part of investor files
breakdown.body: DSCR loans traditionally require tedious manual reviews of rental income, lease agreements, and market rents, dragging out closing timelines for active portfolio builders.

breakdown.heading: Automating property valuations at scale
breakdown.body: By integrating automated valuation models and portfolio analytics, the platform aims to price and approve investor risk without human bottlenecks.

breakdown.heading: The hidden danger in automated cash flow
breakdown.body: Here is what this actually changes when a file hits underwriting: algorithms must correctly interpret complex lease terms and vacancy deductions without missing red flags.

breakdown.heading: Scaling up after strategic acquisitions
breakdown.body: Following the Kiavi purchase, this technology rollout signals a major push to dominate non-owner-occupied lending through pure software efficiency.

carousels.my_take_heading: Speed without sanity checks is a trap
carousels.my_take: Fast approvals are great until an algorithm misreads a lease agreement and funds a cash-flowing property that is actually vacant.
carousels.action_lo: Test fast-processing investor platforms on your next straightforward deal before trusting them with complex multi-unit portfolios.
carousels.action_realtor: Tell your investor clients that tech-driven lenders can win bidding wars by closing deals faster than traditional portfolio shops.
carousels.cta_question: Would you trust an AI-driven platform to underwrite a complex multi-property investor portfolio in just a few days?
